name: Interface Coherence
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: Whether two cell types meet along one front or in specks.

params.name: field
params.label: Grouping column
params.help:
Which annotation the boundaries are drawn between.
Defaults to the cell-type column.

params.name: min_interface
params.label: Minimum reportable interface
params.help:
Sets the minimum shared boundary required for a group pair to appear in the matrix and table, measured in cell diameters.
It does not change the map or the calculated boundaries.

params.name: edge_prune
params.label: Edge pruning distance
params.help:
Drop Delaunay edges longer than this many median cell spacings, so no boundary is created across a lumen or tissue gap.
(The empty-circle criterion used to construct Delaunay triangles does not impose a maximum edge length and could otherwise connect cells across such gaps.)

params.name: n_shuffles
params.label: Label shuffles
params.help:
Sets how many times the group labels are randomly shuffled to create the reference used to score each pair.
More shuffles give a more stable comparison but increase runtime.

params.name: type_a
params.label: Pair member A
params.help:
First member of the pair drawn in the segment-length curve. It is used only to select the pair shown against the dashed white shuffled-label curve.
Defaults to the longest reportable interface.
